title: RunView
description: Response of GET /v1/fleet/runs/{run_id}/view (added in 3.3): a run on another fleet member as this caller sees it now. `reachable` carries the member's own answer, its true state. `unreachable` says the member does not answer this caller; it says nothing about the run, which may be running, finished or gone. `unreachable` is a view computed by the calling core on each read and never stored, there or on the member: no state, event or file is written for it. A run's stored terminal state `unknown` is still written only by the core that owns the run, with evidence that its worker is gone. A run read as unreachable can end in any terminal state, and shows it as soon as its member answers again.

node.description: The member the run id names.

view.description: `reachable`: `run` is the member's answer just now. `unreachable`: `unreachable` says why. Never `succeeded` or any other run state: a caller that cannot read a run does not know its state.

run.description: Present exactly when `view` is `reachable`: the run as the member answered.

reason.description: `not_listed`: the member is in this core's trust list but is not in its member list: it never announced itself, or has been silent for longer than the silence limit (15 s, so a halted member reads unreachable within 16 s of its last announcement). `no_answer`: the member is listed but the call to it failed or timed out (within 5 s of the call).

detail.description: This core's message about why, at most 500 characters.
